verdict.rationale: API parity is a fair question for secret-scanning products. Gitleaks.io describes a team scanning offering, but the pack shows no documented API, and probes for OpenAPI/Swagger specs all returned 404. Gitleaks' interface is a local CLI (git/dir/stdin commands), and the gitleaks-action calls GitHub's API rather than exposing its own, so neither counts as a product API offering parity with a UI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
